description: Rep. Jason Osborne (R-Auburn) will become New Hampshire House Majority Leader when the new session begins, NH Journal confirmed. The four-term representative had served as the Republican policy leader for the caucus during the prior biennium, a role colleagues credit with helping unify the House GOP.
